Volunteer handbook excerpt

Stewards water the tomato beds before nine each morning.
The old rota of one steward per month was dropped after a dry summer.

No pesticides are used anywhere in the garden.
Companion planting keeps pests away from the tomato beds.
Mulch keeps the soil moist between waterings.
The harvest report goes to member households each month.
